title: Component Composition Strategies
description: Master component composition techniques including slot patterns, headless UI, polymorphic components, and layout composition.
longDescription: This module covers advanced component composition strategies for building flexible, reusable UI components. You will learn slot patterns for flexible content injection, headless component architecture, polymorphic components with the 'as' pattern, layout composition with React children, and how to design component APIs that balance flexibility with simplicity.
whatYouLearn: Implement slot patterns for flexible content injection
Build headless components that separate logic from presentation
Create polymorphic components using the 'as' pattern
Compose layouts and wrappers using React children and clones
Design component APIs that are both flexible and easy to use
